descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose Working at the heart of the business and in close partnership with the Corporate HR team, the Senior HR Business Partner provides strategic and hands-on HR support to assigned corporate functions and offices worldwide, within a fast-paced, service-driven hospitality environment. Reporting to the Head of HR, this role partners with senior leaders to translate business priorities into effective people solutions, while ensuring consistent application of Group HR policies, processes, and standards. The Senior HRBP plays a key role in driving performance, engagement, and organisational effectiveness in a complex, international organisation where operational excellence, agility, and customer focus are critical. Your Impact - Act as the primary HR partner for assigned corporate functions, providing strategic advice and operational HR support aligned with business objectives; - Equip leaders with the tools, frameworks, and guidance required to effectively manage their teams in line with Group values and people policies; - Partner with senior leaders to support workforce planning and organisational needs, ensuring capabilities and capacity are aligned with current and future business requirements; - Collaborate closely with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers to define recruitment needs and support delivery of hiring plans in line with agreed KPIs; - Drive performance and accountability by supporting the implementation of the Group performance management framework, including goal setting, evaluation cycles, and manager capability building; - Support talent management processes within the business perimeter, including talent reviews, identification of high-potential employees, succession discussions, and development actions, in coordination with the Head of HR and relevant Centers of Expertise; - Advise managers on employee relations matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and compliant people decisions; - Support change management and organisational initiatives by assessing people impact, supporting leaders through transitions, and ensuring clear and effective communication; - Contribute to key HR cycles such as annual compensation reviews, talent reviews, and employee engagement initiatives; - Work closely with HR Operations, Payroll, and HRIS teams to ensure smooth execution of HR processes and digital tools; - Participate in global HR projects and initiatives, contributing business insight and supporting effective local implementation; - Conduct exit interviews, analyse turnover trends, and contribute to retention and engagement actions within the business perimeter. Your Journey so far - Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; - Minimum 10 years of progressive HR experience in a matrixed, multinational environment, including at least 5 -7 years in a Senior HR Business Partner or equivalent role; - Proven HR experience within the hospitality, cruise, travel or customer-centric industry, with a strong understanding of service culture; - Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders in a corporate or headquarters environment; - Strong project management skills, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver HR initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and tight timelines; - Solid exposure to performance management, talent processes, employee relations, and organisational support; - Experience working with global HR policies, frameworks, and HR systems (HRIS); - Knowledge of Swiss Labour Law is an advantage; - Fluent in English; French is an advantage. Your Essentials - Strong business acumen with the ability to translate strategy into pragmatic HR solutions; - Credible and confident advisor, able to influence, challenge, and build trust with senior stakeholders; - Strong understanding of hospitality and service excellence cultures, with the ability to balance people care, performance, and operational demands; - Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment. - Structured, reliable, and comfortable operating across multiple priorities; - Collaborative mindset, with the ability to work effectively across HR functions and with diverse stakeholders; - High standards of integrity, discretion, and professional judgment; - Flexible, resilient, and solution-oriented, with a continuous improvement mindset. Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

In line with current and future tourism trends, the Shore Excursions Product Development Manager oversees product content and delivery, negotiates costs, and develops new tours to grow revenue and enhance guest satisfaction in specific geographical regions.

Your Impact

- Lead the development of innovative shore excursion products and manage the tour program for assigned regions.

- Source and procure high-quality excursions in line with seasonal demand and company standards.

- Monitor market trends, guest preferences, and potential risks to develop effective action and improvement plans.

- Analyze guest feedback and satisfaction scores to drive continuous product and service enhancements.

- Build and maintain relationships with up to 100 tour operators, overseeing a portfolio of 1,000+ tours.

- Negotiate contracts with suppliers, manage large-scale bids, and optimize costs to ensure profitability and efficiency.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Insurance, and Operations teams to ensure compliance and risk mitigation.

- Oversee product creation, feedback analysis, and product revamping to maintain competitive and engaging offerings.

- Ensure inventory accuracy and perform regular site inspections within assigned destinations.

- Represent the company at government meetings, industry events, and travel conventions to strengthen partnerships and brand presence.

Your Journey so far

- 10 years of experience in the Shore Excursions Department within the cruise industry (either onboard or ashore) is preferred. Experience in shore excursion operations within the hospitality industry or with a global tour operator may also be considered.

- 5–10+ years of proven experience in global shore excursion operations is required, including product development, bid management, and cross-functional collaboration with legal, insurance, and operations stakeholders.

- A bachelor’s degree in tourism and proficiency in multiple languages are highly preferred.

Your Essentials

- Flexibility and strong analytical skills.

- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

- IT-savvy; experience with Fidelio is highly advantageous.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Publisher).

- Extensive knowledge of shore excursion products and operational delivery.

- Fluent in English with a good command of Italian; additional languages are an asset.

- Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time.

- Must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

titleByLocale.it: Direttore delle Operazioni - Infrastrutture di accoglienza

descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Direttore delle Operazioni è responsabile per la progettazione, la mobilitazione, l'apertura e il funzionamento in corso di grandi dimensioni navi da crociera e infrastrutture di ospitalità. Il ruolo assicura la continuità dello sviluppo attraverso operazioni a stato costante, agendo come proprietario operativo dalle prime fasi di costruzione attraverso prestazioni a lungo termine. Lavorando in parallelo con lo sviluppo, la costruzione e l'esperienza degli ospiti, il direttore delle operazioni garantisce che i beni sono operabili dal design, completamente pronti all'apertura e in modo sostenibile, sicuro e redditizio in seguito. Il vostro impatto 1. Leadership operativa Attraverso il ciclo di vita delle risorse proprie responsabilità operativa end-to-end dalla pre-apertura attraverso operazioni dal vivo. Definire la visione operativa a lungo termine, KPI e standard di servizio. Garantire continuità di progettazione, cultura e sistemi dalla fase di progetto alle operazioni a stato costante. 2. Pre-apertura e mobilitazione (Parallel to Construction) Guidare il programma di disponibilità operativa allineato con pietre miliari di costruzione. In coordinamento con Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment ecc.), definisce le esigenze di Procurements e implementarlo. FFE/OWS. Decisioni di progettazione di influenza per garantire efficienza operativa, sicurezza e manutenbilità. Stabilire strutture operative, SOP e governance ben prima dell'apertura. Gestire gli abbonamenti dalla costruzione alle operazioni, compresi i fatturato phased. Per ogni progetto, identificare le necessità del personale e - in combinazione con le risorse umane- garantire la capacità operativa di nuovi asset. Stabilire programmi di formazione per la disponibilità operativa. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Operazioni giornaliere dirette in tutti i dipartimenti (ospitalità, F&B, vendita al dettaglio, attrazioni, marine, sicurezza, manutenzione, servizi ospiti). Assicurare la consegna di esperienze, sicurezza, qualità dei servizi e standard di marca. Guidare la stabilità operativa durante le fasi di rampa e maturità. Condurre iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso il bene. 4. Forza di lavoro, formazione e cultura costruire, condurre e mantenere una forza lavoro multinazionale ad alto rendimento. Mantenere ed evolvere i programmi di formazione post-apertura. Integra una cultura orientata alla sicurezza e alle prestazioni. 5. Financial & Commercial Performance Own operativo P&L, controlli dei costi e metriche di produttività. Gestisci bilanci operativi, capex pianificazione e riserve del ciclo di vita. Collaborare con i team commerciali per ottimizzare i ricavi (F&B, retail, esperienze, escursioni a riva dove applicabile). 6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management Assicurare il rispetto costante di tutti gli standard normativi, marittimi, sanitari, di sicurezza e ambientali. Guidare la preparazione di emergenza, la gestione delle crisi e la pianificazione della continuità aziendale. Servire come responsabile per gli audit e le ispezioni. Il vostro viaggio finora - 15+ anni senior operazioni leadership in ospitalità, destinazioni da crociera, resort, porti, parchi a tema o grandi attività di ospitalità. - Proprietà dimostrata delle operazioni pre-apertura e a lungo termine. - Forte background che lavora insieme a team di sviluppo, costruzione e servizi tecnici. - Esperienza in ambienti caraibici o isolati fortemente preferito. Il vostro Essentials - Operazioni di prontezza e di ciclo di vita - Leader della forza lavoro su larga scala - Contabilità finanziaria e P&L - Gestione del ciclo di vita e della manutenzione - Gestione multioperatoria e delle concessioni Il nostro impegno Siamo impegnati a costruire un futuro che valorizza prospettive diverse, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valutato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il loro sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose The Director of Operations is accountable for the design, mobilization, opening and ongoing operation of large-scale cruise and hospitality infrastructure assets. The role ensures continuity from development through steady-state operations, acting as the operational owner from early construction phases through long-term performance. Working in parallel with Development, Construction and Guest Experience, the Director of Operations guarantees that assets are operable by design, fully ready at opening, and sustainably efficient, safe and profitable thereafter. Your Impact 1. Operational Leadership Across the Asset Lifecycle Own end-to-end operational responsibility from pre-opening through live operations. Define the long-term operating vision, KPIs and service standards. Ensure continuity of design, culture and systems from project phase into steady-state operations. 2. Pre-Opening & Mobilization (Parallel to Construction) Lead the operational readiness program aligned with construction milestones. In coordination with Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment etc.), define Procurements needs and implement it. FFE/OWS. Influence design decisions to ensure operational efficiency, safety and maintainability. Establish operating structures, SOPs and governance well ahead of opening. Manage handovers from construction to operations, including phased turnovers. For each project, identify personnel need and -in conjunction with HR- ensure the operational ability of new assets. Establish Training Programs for operational readiness. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Direct daily operations across all departments (hospitality, F&B, retail, attractions, marine, security, maintenance, guest services). Ensure delivery of guest experience, safety, service quality and brand standards. Drive operational stability during ramp-up and maturity phases. Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the asset. 4. Workforce, Training & Culture Build, lead and retain a high-performing, multi-national workforce. Maintain and evolve training programs post-opening. Embed a safety-first, service-oriented and performance-driven culture. 5. Financial & Commercial Performance Own operational P&L, cost controls and productivity metrics. Manage operating budgets, capex planning and lifecycle reserves. Collaborate with commercial teams to optimize revenue (F&B, retail, experiences, shore excursions where applicable). 6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management Ensure ongoing compliance with all regulatory, maritime, health, safety and environmental standards. Lead emergency preparedness, crisis management and business continuity planning. Serve as the accountable executive for audits and inspections. descriptionByLocale.de: Ihr Ziel Der Operationsdirektor ist verantwortlich für das Design, die Mobilisierung, die Eröffnung und den laufenden Betrieb von großen Kreuzfahrt- und Gastfreundschaft-Infrastrukturanlagen. Die Rolle sorgt für Kontinuität von der Entwicklung durch stationäre Operationen, die als Betriebsinhaber von frühen Bauphasen durch langfristige Leistung fungieren. Parallel zur Entwicklungs-, Bau- und Gasterfahrung garantiert der Leiter der Geschäftstätigkeit, dass die Vermögenswerte durch Design, vollständig bereit zur Eröffnung und nachhaltig effizient, sicher und profitabel sind. Ihre Auswirkungen 1. Operationelle Führung über den Asset Lifecycle Eigene operative End-to-End-Verantwortung von der Voröffnung durch Live-Operationen. Definieren Sie die Langzeit-Betriebsvision, Kennzahlen und Servicestandards. Gewährleistung der Kontinuität von Design, Kultur und Systemen von der Projektphase bis hin zu stationären Betrieben. 2. Pre-Opening & Mobilization (Parallel to Construction) Führen Sie das betriebsbereite Programm im Einklang mit Bau Meilensteinen. In Abstimmung mit Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment etc.) definieren Sie die Beschaffungsbedürfnisse und implementieren sie. FFE/OWS. Einflussentscheidungen zur Sicherstellung der betrieblichen Effizienz, Sicherheit und Aufrechterhaltungsfähigkeit. Stellen Sie operative Strukturen, SOPs und Governance vor der Eröffnung fest. Manage Handover von Bau zu Betrieb, einschließlich phased Umsatz. Für jedes Projekt sorgen Personalbedarf und - in Verbindung mit Personal - die operativen Fähigkeiten neuer Vermögenswerte. Ausbildungsprogramme für Betriebsbereitschaft einrichten. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Direkte tägliche Operationen in allen Abteilungen (Krankheit, F&B, Einzelhandel, Attraktionen, Marine, Sicherheit, Wartung, Gastdienste). Vergewissern Sie sich die Lieferung von Gästeerlebnis, Sicherheit, Servicequalität und Markenstandards. Führen Sie die Betriebsstabilität während der Hoch- und Reifephase aus. Führen Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen in der gesamten Anlage. 4. Workforce, Training & Culture Aufbauen, führen und behalten eine hochperformierende, multinationale Arbeitskräfte. Bewahren und entwickeln Sie Trainingsprogramme nach der Öffnung. Eine sicherheitserste, serviceorientierte und leistungsorientierte Kultur einbetten. 5. Finanz- und Handelsleistung Eigene operative P&L, Kostenkontrollen und Produktivitätskennzahlen. Verwalten Sie Betriebsbudgets, Capex-Planung und Lebenszyklusreserven. Zusammenarbeit mit kommerziellen Teams zur Optimierung des Umsatzes (F&B, Einzelhandel, Erfahrungen, Küstenausflüge, gegebenenfalls). 6. Compliance, Sicherheits- und Risikomanagement Gewährleistung der fortlaufenden Einhaltung aller regulatorischen, maritimen, gesundheitlichen, Sicherheits- und Umweltstandards. Führen Sie Notfallvorbereitung, Krisenmanagement und Unternehmenskontinuitätsplanung. Servieren Sie als verantwortliche Exekutive für Audits und Inspektionen. Ihre Reise so weit - 15+ Jahre Senior Operationen Führung in der Gastfreundschaft, Kreuzfahrt Ziele, Resorts, Häfen, Themenparks oder große Gastfreundschaft Vermögenswerte. - Demonstriertes Eigentum an Vor- und Langzeitoperationen. - Starker Hintergrund, der neben Entwicklungs-, Bau- und technischen Serviceteams arbeitet. - Erfahrung in karibischen oder Inselumgebungen stark bevorzugt. Ihre Essenzen - Betriebsbereitschaft und Lebenszyklusbetrieb - Große Personalführung - Finanz- und P&L- Rechenschaftspflicht - Asset Lifecycle & Maintenance Management - Multioperator und Konzessionsmanagement Unser Engagement Wir sind verpflichtet, eine Zukunft aufzubauen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertet, die Welt jenseits der Grenzen umarmt und eine integrative Umgebung fördert, in der jeder Mensch sich wertschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, seine authentischen Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Handlungen, die langfristig positive Auswirkungen auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten haben. Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Besuchen Sie uns bei MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten erwartet werden. Wenden Sie sich heute an, Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen drängt und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!
descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre but Le Directeur des opérations est responsable de la conception, de la mobilisation, de l'ouverture et de l'exploitation continue de grands équipements de croisière et d'accueil. Ce rôle assure la continuité du développement par des opérations en état d'équilibre, agissant en tant que propriétaire opérationnel depuis les premières phases de construction jusqu'à la performance à long terme. Parallèlement au développement, à la construction et à l'expérience des invités, le Directeur des opérations garantit que les actifs sont exploitables par la conception, prêts à l'ouverture et durables, sûrs et rentables par la suite. 1. Leadership opérationnel Tout au long du cycle de vie de l'actif Responsabilité opérationnelle de bout en bout de la préouverture à des opérations réelles. Définir la vision opérationnelle à long terme, les ICR et les normes de service. Assurer la continuité de la conception, de la culture et des systèmes depuis la phase du projet jusqu'aux opérations en état d'équilibre. 2. Préouverture et mobilisation (parallèle à la construction) Diriger le programme de préparation opérationnelle aligné sur les étapes de construction. En coordination avec les Services invités (F&B, HK, Entertainment, etc.), définir les besoins en matière d'approvisionnement et les mettre en oeuvre. - Oui. Influencer les décisions de conception pour assurer l'efficacité opérationnelle, la sécurité et la maintenance. Établir les structures opérationnelles, les PON et la gouvernance bien avant l'ouverture. Gérer les transferts de la construction à l'exploitation, y compris les roulements échelonnés. Pour chaque projet, déterminer les besoins en personnel et, de concert avec les RH, assurer la capacité opérationnelle des nouveaux biens. Établir des programmes de formation pour la préparation opérationnelle. 3. Gestion des opérations après l'ouverture Diriger les opérations quotidiennes dans tous les ministères (hôpital, F&B, détail, attractions, maritime, sécurité, entretien, services aux clients). Assurer la livraison de l'expérience client, la sécurité, la qualité du service et les normes de marque. Conduire la stabilité opérationnelle pendant les phases de montée en puissance et de maturité. Diriger des initiatives d'amélioration continue dans l'ensemble de l'actif. 4. Main-d'œuvre, formation et culture Construisez, dirigez et maintenez une main-d'oeuvre multinationale hautement performante. Maintenir et développer les programmes de formation après l'ouverture. Intégrer une culture axée sur la sécurité, le service et la performance. 5. Rendement financier et commercial Propre P&L opérationnelle, contrôle des coûts et indicateurs de productivité. Gérer les budgets d'exploitation, la planification du capex et les réserves du cycle de vie. Collaborer avec des équipes commerciales pour optimiser les revenus (F&B, détail, expériences, excursions à terre, le cas échéant). 6. Conformité, sécurité et gestion des risques Assurer la conformité continue à toutes les normes réglementaires, maritimes, sanitaires, de sécurité et environnementales. Diriger la préparation aux situations d'urgence, la gestion des crises et la planification de la continuité des opérations. Servir de cadre supérieur responsable pour les vérifications et les inspections. Votre voyage jusqu'à présent - 15 ans et plus leadership des opérations seniors dans l'hospitalité, les destinations de croisière, les stations balnéaires, les ports, les parcs à thème ou les grands actifs d'accueil. - Démonstration de la propriété des opérations avant l'ouverture et à long terme. - Forte expérience en collaboration avec les équipes de développement, de construction et de services techniques. - L'expérience dans les Caraïbes ou les îles est fortement préférée. Vos essentiels - Préparation opérationnelle et fonctionnement du cycle de vie - Leadership à grande échelle de la main-d'oeuvre - Responsabilité financière et P&L - Cycle de vie des actifs et gestion de l'entretien - Multi-exploitant et gestion des concessions Notre engagement Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les perspectives diverses, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être son authentique soi. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète. Prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous au MSC Cruises, où de nouvelles opportunités attendent. Appliquer aujourd'hui pour faire partie d'une équipe mondiale qui repousse les frontières et réalise quelque chose de remarquable. Votre voyage commence ici !

descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose In line with current and future tourism trends, the Shore Excursions Product Development Manager oversees product content and delivery, negotiates costs, and develops new tours to grow revenue and enhance guest satisfaction in specific geographical regions. Your Impact - Lead the development of innovative shore excursion products and manage the tour program for assigned regions. - Source and procure high-quality excursions in line with seasonal demand and company standards. - Monitor market trends, guest preferences, and potential risks to develop effective action and improvement plans. - Analyze guest feedback and satisfaction scores to drive continuous product and service enhancements. - Build and maintain relationships with up to 100 tour operators, overseeing a portfolio of 1,000+ tours. - Negotiate contracts with suppliers, manage large-scale bids, and optimize costs to ensure profitability and efficiency. - Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Insurance, and Operations teams to ensure compliance and risk mitigation. - Oversee product creation, feedback analysis, and product revamping to maintain competitive and engaging offerings. - Ensure inventory accuracy and perform regular site inspections within assigned destinations. - Represent the company at government meetings, industry events, and travel conventions to strengthen partnerships and brand presence. Your Journey so far - 10 years of experience in the Shore Excursions Department within the cruise industry (either onboard or ashore) is preferred. Experience in shore excursion operations within the hospitality industry or with a global tour operator may also be considered. - 5–10+ years of proven experience in global shore excursion operations is required, including product development, bid management, and cross-functional collaboration with legal, insurance, and operations stakeholders. - A bachelor’s degree in tourism and proficiency in multiple languages are highly preferred. Your Essentials - Flexibility and strong analytical skills. - Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. - IT-savvy; experience with Fidelio is highly advantageous. - Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Publisher). - Extensive knowledge of shore excursion products and operational delivery. - Fluent in English with a good command of Italian; additional languages are an asset. - Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time. - Must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland. Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario. Il tuo scopo Il Destination Experience Manager è pienamente responsabile per le prestazioni, lo sviluppo e l'eccellenza operativa delle regioni assegnate. Questo ruolo richiede una forte esperienza di crociera sulle coste, una profonda conoscenza dei porti e della logistica di destinazione, e una solida comprensione delle operazioni a bordo. Il Manager sovrintende al ciclo di vita completo delle esperienze di destinazione, dal sourcing e dal contrarsi alla consegna a bordo e alle prestazioni finanziarie. Il tuo impatto Destinazione e gestione dei prodotti
• Sviluppare e gestire le esperienze di destinazione nelle regioni assegnate
• Scout e contrarre TOs/DMC attraverso offerte strutturate e trattative
• Assicurarsi che le esperienze siano fattibili e allineate agli standard del marchio di lusso
• Gestione dei prezzi, ROI e pianificazione delle capacità
• Superare il coordinamento dei contenuti con il Marketing e il caricamento del sistema (Seaware, Otalio, ecc.) Supporto operativo onboard &
• Assicurare che i prodotti riflettano le realtà a bordo (timing, demografie degli ospiti, considerazioni sulla mobilità)
• Treno e supporto a bordo
• Assistere con escalation, rimborsi e recupero dei servizi quando necessario
• Monitorare il feedback degli ospiti e implementare azioni correttive Gestione finanziaria e delle prestazioni
• Prestito bilancio e rendimento delle entrate per le regioni assegnate
• Monitorare i margini, le tendenze del rimborso e il contributo a livello di viaggio
• Identificare le porte sottoperformanti e ottimizzare le offerte di conseguenza
• Partner con Finance e Analytics per report e dashboard Il tuo viaggio finora - 7–10+ anni di escursioni in crociera lungo la costa, gestione della destinazione o viaggio di lusso - Corso di laurea in Ospitalità, Turismo, Business o esperienza equivalente preferito. I tuoi essenziali - Forte esperienza di crociera a bordo e comprensione operativa - Conoscenza profonda dei porti e delle infrastrutture di destinazione - La conoscenza delle regioni dell'Alaska, dei Caraibi, del Sud America o dell'Asia è un forte vantaggio - Prove capacità di negoziazione e gestione finanziaria - Forte capacità analitiche e di comunicazione - Fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un bene - Valido permesso di lavoro svizzero o idoneità al lavoro in Svizzera / permesso USA per la posizione di Miami A Explora Journeys, stiamo ridefinindo il viaggio oceanico di lusso - dove la scoperta, il benessere, e un profondo rispetto per i mari si uniscono in armonia. Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare. Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Where passion meets opportunity Discover your journey into the extraordinary. Your Purpose The Destination Experience Manager is fully responsible for the performance, development, and operational excellence of assigned regions. This role requires strong cruise shore excursion experience, deep knowledge of ports and destination logistics, and a solid understanding of onboard operations. The Manager oversees the full lifecycle of destination experiences — from sourcing and contracting to onboard delivery and financial performance. Your Impact Destination & Product Management
• Develop and manage destination experiences across assigned regions
• Scout and contract TOs/DMCs through structured bidding and negotiation
• Ensure experiences are operationally feasible and aligned with luxury brand standards
• Manage pricing, ROI, and capacity planning
• Oversee content coordination with Marketing and system loading (Seaware, Otalio, etc.) Onboard & Operational Support
• Ensure products reflect onboard realities (timings, guest demographics, mobility considerations)
• Train and support onboard Destination teams
• Assist with escalations, refunds, and service recovery when required
• Monitor guest feedback and implement corrective actions Financial & Performance Management
• Own budgeting and revenue performance for assigned regions
• Monitor margins, refund trends, and voyage-level contribution
• Identify underperforming ports and optimize offerings accordingly
• Partner with Finance and Analytics on reporting and dashboards Your Journey so far - 7–10+ years in cruise shore excursions, destination management, or luxury travel - Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality, Tourism, Business, or equivalent experience preferred. Your Essentials - Strong onboard cruise experience and operational understanding - Deep knowledge of ports and destination infrastructure - Knowledge of Alaska, Caribbean, South America, or Asia regions is a strong advantage - Proven negotiation and financial management skills - Strong analytical and communication abilities - Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset - Valid Swiss work permit or eligibility to work in Switzerland / US permit for Miami position At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony. We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea. Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Où la passion rencontre des opportunités Découvrez votre voyage dans l'extraordinaire. Votre but Le gestionnaire de l'expérience de destination est entièrement responsable du rendement, du développement et de l'excellence opérationnelle des régions désignées. Ce rôle exige une solide expérience d'excursion à terre de croisière, une connaissance approfondie des ports et de la logistique de destination, et une bonne compréhension des opérations à bord. Le gestionnaire supervise l'ensemble du cycle de vie des expériences de destination, de l'approvisionnement et de la passation de marchés à la prestation à bord et au rendement financier. Votre impact Gestion de la destination et des produits
• Développer et gérer les expériences de destination dans les régions désignées
• Scout et contrat des TO/DMC par des appels d'offres et des négociations structurés
• Veiller à ce que les expériences soient opérationnelles et conformes aux normes de la marque de luxe
• Gérer les prix, le ROI et la planification des capacités
• Surveiller la coordination du contenu avec le marketing et le chargement du système (Seaware, Otalio, etc.) Soutien embarqué et opérationnel
• Veiller à ce que les produits reflètent les réalités de bord (timings, démographie des clients, mobilité)
• Train et assistance à bord des équipes de destination
• Aider aux escalades, aux remboursements et à la récupération des services au besoin
• Surveiller la rétroaction des clients et mettre en œuvre des mesures correctives Gestion financière et du rendement
• Résultats budgétaires et recettes propres pour les régions affectées
• Surveiller les marges, les tendances des remboursements et la contribution au niveau du voyage
• Identifier les ports sous-performants et optimiser les offres en conséquence
• Partenaire avec Finance et Analytics sur les rapports et les tableaux de bord Votre voyage jusqu'à présent - 7-10 ans et plus en croisières, gestion de destination ou voyages de luxe - Baccalauréat en hôtellerie, tourisme, affaires ou expérience équivalente préféré. Vos essentiels - Forte expérience de croisière à bord et compréhension opérationnelle - Connaissance approfondie des ports et des infrastructures de destination - La connaissance des régions de l'Alaska, des Caraïbes, de l'Amérique du Sud ou de l'Asie est un fort avantage - Compétences éprouvées en négociation et en gestion financière - Fortes capacités d'analyse et de communication - Fluent en anglais; les langues supplémentaires sont un atout - Permis de travail suisse valide ou éligibilité pour travailler en Suisse / permis américain pour le poste de Miami À Explora Journeys, nous redéfinissons le voyage maritime de luxe, où la découverte, le bien-être et le profond respect des mers s'unissent en harmonie. Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés qui partagent notre vision d'une façon plus immersive et transformatrice de découvrir les destinations les plus inspirantes du monde par la mer. Êtes-vous prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous à Explora Journeys, où un océan d'opportunités vous attend. Votre voyage vers l'état de l'océan commence ici.

descriptionByLocale.it: Join our team as a CRM Director, where you will lead data-driven customer engagement programs and lifecycle marketing strategies. Leverage your expertise in CRM and marketing automation to drive commercial growth and enhance customer loyalty. Be part of a vibrant luxury brand redefining the cruise experience!
descriptionByLocale.en:
Where passion meets opportunity Discover your journey into the extraordinary. Your Purpose Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers. The CRM Director – Insights, Customer Lifecycle & Marketing Automation leads the strategy and activation of data-driven customer engagement programs to inform the business and support commercial growth, loyalty and lifetime value. The role acts as business lead for lifecycle marketing and marketing automation, working in close partnership with Commercial, Digital, IT, Data and Legal teams to ensure scalable, compliant and high-performing customer communications. He/ She leads the customer’s insights area recommending how to approach the brand evolution assessment. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland. Your Impact 1. Lifecycle Strategy & Co-Ownership
• Lead the definition of the global customer lifecycle strategy organizing the customer journey vision with Commercial, Digital and Guest Experience teams.
• Translate lifecycle ambition into structured activation roadmaps across owned marketing automation channels.
• Define lifecycle design principles, segmentation logic and engagement frameworks aligned with brand and commercial objectives.
• Ensure cross-functional alignment between customer experience, commercial priorities and lifecycle communications. 2. Journey Activation & Channel Governance
• Lead automated journey orchestration primarily across owned CRM channels
• Establish governance for segmentation, personalization and campaign standards.
• Coordinate with other channel owners (e.g., Media, Social, Digital) to ensure journey consistency.
• Drive structured adoption of personalization and audience activation tools. 3. Platform Business Ownership
• Act as business product owner of marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud).
• Define functional requirements, prioritization and business roadmap.
• Partner with IT, as technical owner, for architecture, integrations, security and scalability.
• Ensure operational excellence of automations, data flows and activation processes. 4. Data Governance & Compliance
• Define lifecycle communication standards in alignment with Legal and IT.
• Ensure consent management and subscription governance frameworks are operationalized within marketing automation tools.
• Support privacy-by-design principles across activation use cases. 5. Commercial Impact & Performance
• Define CRM contribution metrics and dashboards.
• Monitor engagement, retention and revenue influence.
• Provide optimization roadmaps to senior leadership. 6. Lead the development of a customer insights framework, leveraging CRM data, external ad hoc research to inform brand health evolution. Translate customer understanding into actionable growth opportunities. Partner with Guest Experience teams, Marketing and Commercial teams to design and prioritize customer research initiatives, including satisfaction tracking, journey analysis, loyalty drivers, brand tracking,etc. 7. Team & Capability Building
• Build a high-performing marketing CRM team.
• Elevate internal understanding of marketing automation capabilities and limitations.
• Drive adoption and maturity of audience strategy and segmentation practices. Your Journey so far
• 15+ years of experience in CRM, customer lifecycle management, marketing automation or customer data roles, ideally in global and local environments.
• Proven experience driving customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty and retention through CRM at scale.
• Proven experience designing and managing complex customer journeys across multiple channels, markets and touchpoints, including long consideration and purchase cycles
• Deep understanding of CRM platforms, marketing automation tools and data-driven marketing,
• Solid knowledge on global standards for data capture, consent management, governance, and enrichment
• Strong analytical mindset with experience translating CRM data into actionable insights. Experience leading customer insights initiatives such as segmentation studies, loyalty drivers, NPS/satisfaction research or journey diagnostics.
• Proven people manager, able to build, structure and develop teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
• Strong track record of working hands-on while leading strategically, especially in complex or fast-growth environments.
• Experience managing agencies and external partners.
• Prior experience in luxury, premium or high-end consumer brands strongly preferred as well as Travel & hospitality Your Essentials
• Strategic, customer-centric and commercially minded leader.
• Highly analytical, data-driven and comfortable translating insights into action.
• Technically savvy, with the ability to bridge business, data and technology teams.
• Structured, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
• Outstanding collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to operate in a matrix organization. At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony. We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea. Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.
